messages:
Ana: Quick design review of the compact compare view — spotted a few UX/accessibility issues with the legend, performance badges, and keyboard flow. Posting early Figma frames here: https://figma.com/s/abcd (WIP).
Sam: thanks Ana — can you list top priority items so we can scope?
Ana: Top items (short):
1) Legend clarity — colored dot legend is ambiguous (users can't tell Latency vs Throughput vs Cost at a glance). Suggest explicit short labels and an accessible legend toggle.
2) Badge contrast — badges at 12px with white text currently fail AA on green/yellow combos. Need color or size tweak.
3) Pin persistence — when pinning a model version in compare, state doesn't persist across sessions. Expectation: per-user sticky pins (configurable).
4) Keyboard flow — tab order jumps: compare checkbox is after row actions which is confusing for keyboard users. Tabbing should hit checkbox -> pin -> actions.
5) Tooltip microcopy — current tooltips are terse ("Latency") with no context (time window, aggregation). Recommend 1-line explainer and a CTA to open metric details.
Jamal: noted. for badge contrast can you paste the current hex colors?
Ana: Current badges: green #22c55e, amber #f59e0b, red #ef4444. We use white text on green/red, dark text on amber. In compact density the badge height is ~12px which leaves little room.
Lily: accessibility nit: white text on #22c55e at 12px fails AA for small text (ratio < 4.5:1). Options: increase font-size to 14px, use bold 600 weight, add a 1px outline/stroke, or switch to a darker fill with white text. Also add aria-labels e.g. "Latency: 120 ms (p50)".
Sam: on pin persistence — product decision: do we want sticky pins by default or opt-in?
Ana: prefer sticky by default but behind a tenant-level toggle for enterprise. Also show a small "Pinned" chip in the row header so it's discoverable when you return.
Jamal: implementation notes: persisting requires storing pins in user preferences service + local optimistic cache. Need to account for model version deletions (garbage-collect stale pins). Edge case: pins created on a private model not accessible later.
Ana: Tooltip microcopy proposal (suggested copy):
```
Latency badge — median request latency over the last 24 hours. Click to open latency distribution and recent regressions.
Throughput badge — requests per second (p95) over the last hour. Click to view time-series.
Cost badge — estimated per-1k tokens cost over the last 7 days.
```
Sam: that copy is helpful — maybe shorten for the inline tooltip and expand on the detail panel. Also include a clear keyboard hint in tooltip like "Press Enter to open".
Lily: keyboard flow suggestions: re-order tab stops: 1) compare checkbox, 2) pin button, 3) row actions. Add a skip link at top of catalog grid: "Skip to compare controls" that jumps to compare checkboxes. For screen readers, make compare state announce like "Selected for compare, 2 of 3".
Jamal: quick CSS idea to improve legibility (will prototype):
```
.badge { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; }
.badge.green { background: #198043; color: #fff; }
```
Ana: prefer not to rely on text-shadow for contrast (it can break in zoom). If we darken the background slightly (#198043 vs #22c55e) we keep white text and hit contrast. But test with color blindness simulators.
Sam: accessibility acceptance criteria for the ticket?
Lily: i'll draft ACs: contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for badge text, badges keyboard-focusable with visible focus ring, aria-labels for all badges, tab order documented and validated with NVDA/VoiceOver, tooltip content available to screen readers via aria-describedby.
Jamal: dev estimate: pin persistence + UI changes = medium (2-3 dev days) if we reuse prefs service; otherwise large. Badge color/size tweaks are small (UI only). Keyboard order + skip link small-medium depending on grid implementation.
Ana: i'll upload two Figma variants by EOD — "Dense" (current row height) and "Readable" (+8px row height, 14px badges). I'll annotate legend behavior and draft tooltip text. Tagging @lily @jamal for quick pass. :+1:
dev-bot: Reminder: UX review meeting Thu 10:00 AM — calendar invite shared with #product.
Lily: i'll add the ARIA examples and screen reader readout examples in the ticket description.
Sam: thanks everyone — i'll create follow-up ticket with acceptance criteria and link Figma frames once Ana posts them.
Jamal: i'll spike on prefs service reuse tomorrow and post blocking notes.
